## Specifications

## Tips & gotchas

- Turn the crankshaft clockwise when viewing it from the front of the vehicle. [t35]
- Grease new seal rings on the output shaft with petroleum jelly before installation. [t35]
- Ensure drive plates are aligned and drum support edges match up closely during reassembly. [t35]
